name: Omnea — Agentic OS for Procurement landing page by omnea.co
description: A long editorial enterprise landing page built almost entirely in a warm off-white/beige palette with near-black serif headlines. The hero is minimal — centred type, a single dark pill CTA and a faint dot-matrix motif — followed by a quiet grey logo strip. The page alternates rhythm: dense bento feature grids with UI mockups, a full-bleed dark "agent" section that resets the eye, large stat blocks set in oversized serif numerals, editorial photography with pull-quotes, geometric line-drawn trust/compliance tiles, and finally a testimonial wall, article cards, newsletter capture and a dark closing CTA with a big footer. Small uppercase eyebrow labels with dots organise every section, giving a consistent navigational rhythm despite the varied content.
